claim: All 42,031 planned records are present and the unchanged scientific core and recovered parent journal are preserved.
The predeclared clean-admission-gated semantic composite favors E3-S1 at both strengths; it is not a pure regeneration-survival estimate because clean eligibility and h targets differ.
Descriptive raw source-majority S counts are 287 versus 283 and 284 versus 232; exact Q counts are 294 versus 81 and 297 versus 17. No new secondary significance claim is made.
E3 strict clean quality is 294/300 and v5 is 298/300, so all-source strict quality is false for both.
Both methods have zero source-majority H, D and F after regeneration at both strengths; regeneration-robust full ownership is not established.
No observed A occurs in clean/T3 negative calls, but T3 source families are unresolved for 10 E3 and 3 v5 sources; no population 0.1% FPR claim follows.
E3 public T4 and T5 each deliver D on all 30 pairs and reject all by combined F; this is prescribed-challenge evidence, not a 1% population-security bound.
E3 combined and perceptual-only same-call acceptance are both zero; combined-over-perceptual binding superiority is not established.
Human admissibility, latent insertion, arbitrary-owner security, unseen-model robustness and general journal readiness are not established.
